records.title: Trace the candidate limit in bounded code/schema fixtures
records.statement: The inspected formatter uses a limit of 10. The inspected schema defines material identity and name, not a candidate-limit setting. This static evidence cannot establish end-to-end behavior or approve 20.
open_questions: Would changing the limit affect pagination, performance, or other callers?

investigation.question: Can the proposed candidate-limit change be justified using only the scoped code and schema fixtures?
investigation.method: Static inspection of the frozen lines only. No SQL or repository code was executed.

findings.claim: The formatter slices candidates using MAX_RESULTS = 10.
The complete inspected table definition contains material_code and name; it does not define a candidate-limit setting.
